entries.title: Jeremiah 6:1
segments: Benjamin; Jerusalem lay on the southern border of the tribe of Benjamin.  The Benjamites in great numbers would naturally take refuge in her from the invaders.  But they are here warned to escape, as she will fall into the hands of the enemy.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:3
segments:
Shepherds with their flocks; kings with their armies. 
 
  Shall feed; shall destroy her, as flocks consume pasturage.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:4
segments:
vv 4-5. 
 
  Prepare ye war--destroy her palaces; the impatient language of the enemy.  They regret that they cannot reach her before evening, and resolve to continue the march through the night.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:7
segments: Grief and wounds; the grief and wounds caused by her oppression and violence.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:9
segments:
Turn back thy hand; persist in gleaning.  Jehovah here addresses the enemy. 
 
God is slow to inflict punishment upon his people; it is only after expostulation and warning have proved vain, that he gives them over, as he did Jerusalem of old, to desolating judgments.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:10
segments: Shall I speak; the prophet says this.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:11
segments: Full--weary with holding in; I have forborne to speak, because the people would not listen; but I can refrain no longer.  "The fury of the Lord" is the coming wrath of the Lord, which he was commanded to proclaim.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:14
segments: They have healed; the false prophets and priests.

Slightly; they have covered over the festering wound of her iniquity, instead of probing it. 
 
vv 14-15. 
 
The aim of all false doctrine is to flatter men with the hope of impunity in sin; and its result is to make them impudent and hardhearted, and thus plunge them into irremediable ruin.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:16
segments:
Stand ye in the ways; to examine and decide which is the right way. 
 
  The old paths; those prescribed of old by God.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:17
segments:
Watchmen; prophets. 
 
  Sound of the trumpet; warning you of approaching danger.  Compare

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:18
segments: What is among them; what wickedness demanding my judgments.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:20
segments:
Sheba; a region of southern Arabia. 
 
  Burnt-offerings not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet; because they are the offerings of the wicked.
When men's hearts are full of rebellion, and their lives of iniquity, no multiplication of outward rites can be acceptable to God, or avert his displeasure.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:21
segments: I will lay stumbling-blocks; see note on

. 
 
When men do not love the truth, God leaves them to embrace falsehood, which becomes a stumbling-block, to their destruction.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:27
segments:
I have set thee; God addresses the prophet. 
 
  A tower and a fortress;

Know and try their way; by the truth which thou proclaimest from me. 
 
The way in which men treat God's faithful serants and their messages, is a true touchstone of their own character.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:28
segments:
vv 28-30. 
 
They who cannot be purifies by God's discipline, must be destroyed by his judgments.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:29
segments: The bellows--the lead; these were destroyed in the vain effort to separate the silver from the dross; that is, to purify the people from sin.  Lead was anciently used in the process of refining.

entries.title: Jeremiah 6:30
segments: Reprobate silver; that cannot be refined, and is therefore worthless.
